name: Contest type
description: Whether a contest fills an office or decides a question. Ballot measures are modelled alongside offices because they appear on the same ballot and are reported in the same returns, but their options are people in one case and propositions in the other.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Office
hasDefinedTerm.description: A contest to fill one or more posts.

hasDefinedTerm.name: Ballot measure
hasDefinedTerm.description: A proposition, referendum question or bond measure put to voters.
